name: piri
description: Moves a stateful app to another Kubernetes cluster without losing a byte, and proves it. Volumes converge over live rsync, then a gated checklist walks the freeze: every irreversible step needs recorded proof before it can advance, and the target needs only a namespace-scoped Role. End-to-end tested against two kind clusters on every push.

name: Flight Recorder (fdr)
description: git blame tells you who, fdr tells you why. A local-first provenance tool for AI-assisted codebases: it joins coding-agent session transcripts with git history into an append-only ledger committed with the code. fdr why <file>:<line> returns the originating task, the agent's stated reasoning and the commit. It runs offline and gives the same answer every time, with no model in the loop.

name: anthias-go
description: Go SDK for the Anthias digital signage player v2 REST API.

name: Energyplus Improvement and Visualization Tool
description: Tool made for evaluating and comparing the energy efficiency of architectural design alternatives. It streamlined the process, reduced comparison time by 81.3% and editing idf time by 57.6%.

name: Model2Image Generator
description: A tool designed to generate object detection model training data from 3D models fetched from various marketplaces.

name: Manage Wifi
description: Added Windows support to the open source project, manage wifi.

name: The New Deal - Negotiation Agent
description: Negotiation agent that is tuned to perform under uncertainty. It is uses the GENIUS Framework.

name: Decentralized Stock Market Blockchain
description: Early development of a decentralized stock market built on Solidity smart contracts. Its aim is to prevent price and purchase manipulation in global stock markets.

name: Digitalized Enigma Machine Reconstruction
description: A project to replicate the original Enigma Machine by using STM32. Main objective in this project is to create a machine that is easy to replicate and can be used to teach the basic concepts of cryptology.

name: Minified Town of Salem
description: A minified take on the social deduction game Town of Salem, built in Java.
